module_summary: Shared-RAM AXI-stream switch: per-input adapters route frames by tdest into per-port virtual FIFOs in one arbitrated RAM, logging frames in command tables; per-output arbiters fetch commands, read RAM into small output FIFOs and adapters.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Shared packet RAM partitioned into per-input virtual FIFOs.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated input stream data into per-port width adapters.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-input stream valid bits.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-input ready from input adapters.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Per-output stream data from output adapters.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-output stream valid bits.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-output downstream ready into output adapters.

anchors.name: ram_wr_sel
anchors.why: Encoded write-arbiter grant selecting which input port writes the RAM.

anchors.name: ram_wr_en
anchors.why: RAM write enable from write arbiter grant valid.

anchors.name: ram_rd_sel
anchors.why: Encoded read-arbiter grant selecting which output port reads the RAM.

anchors.name: ram_rd_en
anchors.why: RAM read enable from read arbiter grant valid.

anchors.name: mem_read_data_reg
anchors.why: RAM read data output pipeline stages.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].select_reg
anchors.why: Destination output port decoded from tdest per input frame.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].select_valid_reg
anchors.why: Route decision valid for current frame; gates input ready and writes.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].drop_reg
anchors.why: Drops frames with unroutable tdest; forces input ready.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer of the input virtual FIFO, advanced on good frame end.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].wr_ptr_cur_reg
anchors.why: Speculative write pointer within current frame; RAM write address source.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO read pointer freed when output commits a frame.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].full
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO full from pointer compare; causes frame drop.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Dropping current frame due to overflow until tlast.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].ram_wr_en_reg
anchors.why: Per-input RAM write request held until arbiter ack.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].overflow_reg
anchors.why: Per-input overflow pulse driving status_overflow.

anchors.name: status_overflow
anchors.why: Per-input overflow status output.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_addr_start
anchors.why: Per-input command table storing frame start address for output readers.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_active
anchors.why: Valid bits of command table entries gating command issue and clean-up.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Command table write pointer, advanced when a good frame is stored.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_read_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Command table pointer of next frame command to issue.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_finish_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Command table retire pointer, frees RAM space after commit.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: One-hot command valid toward the selected output port.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].grant_encoded
anchors.why: Selects which output's completion status this input commits.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_status_valid_mux
anchors.why: Arbitrated completion status triggering command commit.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].grant_encoded
anchors.why: Output command arbiter selection of source input port.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].cmd_valid_mux
anchors.why: Arbitrated command valid accepted by output reader.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Output reader busy with a command; gates reads and command accept.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output reader RAM address for current frame.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].len_reg
anchors.why: Remaining word count of frame being read; zero ends frame.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].ram_rd_en_reg
anchors.why: Per-output RAM read request held until read arbiter ack.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].cmd_status_valid_reg
anchors.why: Completion status back to source input to commit frame.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_fifo_tdata
anchors.why: 32-entry output data FIFO absorbing RAM read latency.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO read pointer feeding output register.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_fifo_ctrl_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output control FIFO write pointer limiting outstanding reads.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_fifo_data_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output data FIFO write pointer advanced on RAM read data.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Output register valid into output width adapter.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Output register data into output width adapter.

groups.name: shared_ram
groups.description: Shared RAM with round-robin write and read port arbiters and read pipeline.

groups.name: input_routing
groups.description: Per-input width adapter and tdest decode to output port select or drop.

groups.name: input_virtual_fifo
groups.description: Per-input virtual FIFO pointers, frame drop/overflow, and RAM write requests.

groups.name: command_table
groups.description: Per-input frame command table issuing read commands and retiring committed frames.

groups.name: status_arbiter
groups.description: Per-input arbiter collecting completion status from outputs.

groups.name: output_cmd_arbiter
groups.description: Per-output arbiter choosing which input's frame command to serve.

groups.name: output_reader
groups.description: Per-output command processor issuing RAM reads and reporting completion.

groups.name: output_fifo
groups.description: Per-output small data/control FIFO, output register and width adapter.
